Hemoglobin.description: Measures the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells.

Glucose.description: Fasting blood sugar level used to evaluate glucose metabolism.

Vitamin D.description: Essential vitamin for bone health and immune regulation.

Cholesterol.description: Total serum cholesterol level evaluating cardiovascular risk.

WBC.description: White blood cell count measuring immune system activity.

Platelets.description: Cell fragments involved in blood clotting and hemostasis.
